name: Caldron Magen
languages: understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Disintegration
special_abilities.desc: If the magen dies, it disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The magen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The magen makes two attacks, using Extended Fist or Acid Spittle in any combination.

actions.name: Extended Fist
actions.desc: m +6, reach 15 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two fists.

actions.name: Acid Spittle
actions.desc: r +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Acid damage.

name: Eldritch Eddy
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The eddy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eddy makes two attacks, using Searing Swipe or Arcane Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Searing Swipe
actions.desc: m +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire or Lightning damage (eddy's choice).

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.desc: r +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Force damage.

reactions.name: Eldritch Overload
reactions.desc: The eddy takes damage. dstr DC 14, each creature of the eddy's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the eddy.  7 (2d6) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

name: Phaerimm Elder
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc:
The phaerimm casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
3/day: Counterspell, Shield

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phaerimm makes three Mind Lash attacks. It can replace one attack with either (A) a Vicious Stinger attack or (B) a use of Spellcasting to cast Command (level 3 version).

actions.name: Mind Lash
actions.desc: m,r +9, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Vicious Stinger
actions.desc: m +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 26 (4d12) Poison damage, and the target's Speed is reduced to 0 feet until the start of the phaerimm's next turn.

actions.name: Siphon Magic (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The phaerimm focuses on a magic item it can see within 10 feet. When it does, the phaerimm drains the magic item of any charges. Regardless of whether charges are drained, the phaerimm can cast Clairvoyance, Geas, Major Image, and Mirage Arcane one additional time that day.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At will: Command (level 3 version), Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand
1/day each: Clairvoyance, Geas, Major Image, Mirage Arcane

name: Phaerimm Scout
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phaerimm makes two attacks, using Stinger or Mindwarp Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: m +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

actions.name: Mindwarp Ray
actions.desc: r +5, range 120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the phaerimm's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand
1/day: Clairvoyance

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: The phaerimm is hit by an attack roll.  The phaerimm halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.
